Overview

One Person Company Registration in Noida

Freelancers, consultants, solo developers, Amazon and Flipkart sellers and independent professionals across Noida often outgrow the proprietorship model: clients want to contract with a company, banks want a corporate borrower, and the owner wants personal assets protected. A One Person Company gives all of that with a single owner-director.

Incorporation is online through the MCA. For a Noida OPC we take care of Uttar Pradesh stamp duty, the nominee's consent in Form INC-3, a matching address proof for your Noida flat or office and the post-incorporation steps — bank account, INC-20A and, if needed, Uttar Pradesh GST registration.

Noida specifics

What is specific to Noida

  • ROC Kanpur is your Registrar after incorporation; the OPC files AOC-4 and the simplified MGT-7A there every year.
  • Uttar Pradesh stamp duty on the MoA, AoA and SPICe+ form, generally modest for small capital.
  • Your Noida residence can be the registered office with the owner's NOC and a recent PVVNL or NPCL bill.
  • The nominee — usually a spouse or parent — need not live in Noida; they sign INC-3 and provide KYC.
  • No AGM is required for an OPC, which keeps annual compliance lighter than a regular private company.

For the full legal detail — eligibility, benefits, comparison tables and law — see the main One Person Company Registration guide. This page covers what changes when your registered office is in Noida.

Checklist

Documents required in Noida

For the member & the nominee

  • PAN card and Aadhaar card
  • Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence
  • Latest bank statement or utility bill (not older than 2 months)
  • Passport-size photograph
  • Email ID and mobile number

Noida registered office

  • Latest electricity bill (PVVNL / NPCL), gas, telephone or mobile bill — not older than 2 months
  • NOC from the property owner
  • Rent agreement, if rented or in a co-working space
  • Allotment letter, sale deed or property tax receipt, if self-owned
Step by step

One Person Company Registration process in Noida

Digital Signature Certificate Day 1–2

Class-3 DSC for the member-director via Aadhaar eKYC.

Name reservation — SPICe+ Part A Day 2–4

Name and trademark check; the name must end with "(OPC) Private Limited".

MoA, AoA & nominee consent Day 3–5

e-MoA, e-AoA, nominee consent in INC-3 and director declarations drafted.

Filing SPICe+ Part B Day 5–7

Incorporation filed with DIN and AGILE-PRO-S; MCA fees and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty paid online.

Certificate of Incorporation Day 7–10

COI with CIN, PAN and TAN by email.

Bank account & commencement After COI

Current account at a Noida branch and INC-20A within 180 days.

FAQs

One Person Company Registration in Noida — common questions

How much does OPC registration cost in Noida?

Professional fee from ₹999, plus one Digital Signature, MCA fees and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty based on authorised capital. Itemised written quote before payment.

Is an OPC better than a proprietorship for a Noida freelancer?

If you invoice corporate clients, want limited liability or plan to hire, yes. A proprietorship is cheaper to run but offers no liability protection and less credibility. The OPC does require a statutory audit and annual ROC filings, which we handle.

Can I later convert my Noida OPC into a Private Limited Company?

Yes, at any time, by adding a second member and director and altering the MoA and AoA. The earlier compulsory conversion thresholds no longer apply.

Who can be my nominee?

Any Indian citizen who is a natural person and has consented in Form INC-3 — most owners choose a spouse, parent or sibling. The nominee can be changed later.

How long does it take?

Typically 7–10 working days from complete documents, the same as a Private Limited Company.
